title: Inexpensive accent piece
text:
Inexpensive accent piece. I had a previous set of these ”lifelike branches” that operated via a battery pack, so I was excited to find a set that said it could be used both indoors and outdoors and that came with an AC adapter versus batteries as well as a timer function.

However, when the lighted brown willow branches arrived, what caught my attention was the cheap feeling of the wiring and components. I don’t know whether this is waterproof enough to be used outdoors given that it uses current.

However, the branches themselves are quite sturdy and can be adjusted. The timer function can be set up to eight hours. The light the branches give off is quite bright and makes an eye-catching accent to a flower arrangement.

I don’t have an outdoor space to try these out in at the moment (or an outside outlet they can be plugged into), but if you are looking for an inexpensive way to accent your living room or porch, these are worth a look.
